tests.q: 怎么只 reset 一个 PCIe function，而不把整个 link 一起重新训练？
tests.e: Port state machines associated with Link functionality including those in the Physical and Data Link Layers are not reset by FLR

tests.q: 发起 Function Level Reset 后，规范要求多久完成？
tests.e: the Function must complete the FLR within 100 ms

tests.q: DPC 期间下游端口收到发往该 Link 的 request 怎么处理？
tests.e: During DPC, the Downstream Port discards Requests destined for the Link and completes them with an error

tests.q: 是不是所有 non-fatal AER error 都应该直接触发 DPC？规范怎么区分？
Flit 的 256B 里 TLP、DLP、CRC、ECC 分别占多少字节？
tests.e: The first 236 Bytes (0..235) are for TLP(s), next 6 Bytes are for Data Link Layer Payload

tests.q: Flit 接收端判断有效时，是先做 FEC correction 还是先看 CRC？
tests.e: CRC check passes after performing FEC correction

tests.q: Replay timer 超时在 Flit Mode 下应该按哪个 replay schedule rule 处理？
tests.e: Replay Timeout rules defined in Replay Schedule Rule 0

tests.q: ATS Translation Request 从设备发出去以后，RC/TA 的基本处理流程在哪里？
tests.e: The Function generates an ATS Translation Request which is sent upstream through the PCIe hierarchy to the RC

tests.q: ATC translation 被 invalidate 时，Function 什么时候才允许宣告 invalidation 完成？
tests.e: required not to indicate the invalidation has completed until all outstanding Read Requests or Translation Requests

tests.q: PASID 自己是不是全局唯一？它到底和什么一起标识 address space？
tests.e: The Process Address Space ID, in conjunction with the Requester ID, uniquely identifies the address space
The PASID field is 20 bits wide

tests.q: LTSSM 链路重训练主要落在哪个大状态？

adversarial.q: FLR 会把 Physical Layer 和 Data Link Layer 的 link state machine 一起 reset，对吗？
adversarial.e: Port state machines associated with Link functionality including those in the Physical and Data Link Layers are not reset by FLR

adversarial.q: 只要收到 ERR_NONFATAL，Switch Downstream Port 就必须触发 DPC，对吗？
adversarial.e: passes ERR_NONFATAL Messages it receives Upstream without triggering DPC

adversarial.q: 收到 ATS Invalidate Request 后可以马上回 Completion，不用等旧 translated read 清掉，对吗？
adversarial.e: required not to indicate the invalidation has completed until all outstanding Read Requests or Translation Requests

adversarial.q: Flit 的 CRC 应该在 FEC correction 之前检查，对吗？
adversarial.e: CRC check passes after performing FEC correction

adversarial.q: PASID=7 在整个系统里就唯一对应一个进程地址空间，不需要 Requester ID，对吗？
adversarial.e: The Process Address Space ID, in conjunction with the Requester ID, uniquely identifies the address space
